transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-03-25
Time: 09:23 PT
Duration: ~45 minutes
Attendees: Maya P., Jon C., Elena R., Tom E., Samir R., Priya S., Lydia P., Jake M.
Recording: internal-redwood-recordings/2026-03-25-it-fin-sec.mp3

[00:00] Maya: ok good morning everyone, thanks for joining the weekly uh IT / finance / security sync. I think we have a packed agenda so we'll try to run through the major blockers first. quick roll call?
[00:12] Jon: Jon here, IT.
[00:14] Elena: Elena, security.
[00:16] Priya: Priya, finance.
[00:18] Tom: Tom, legal.
[00:20] Samir: Samir, platform ops.
[00:22] Lydia: Lydia, payroll.
[00:24] Jake: Jake, facilities.
[00:27] Maya: awesome. first item: SOC2 readiness and auditor scheduling, Elena?
[00:33] Elena: yeah so quick update — we've assembled most of the evidence, there's a small gap on change management logs from January, uh looks like a miss in the automation retention policy. I'm gonna upload the evidence index today but we need one confirmation from infra that the logs are retained for the 12 month window.
[00:49] Jon: that makes sense, we changed the retention last quarter when we moved some ELK clusters, I think a prop — property? — was dropped, so i'll check the retention policy, should be an easy restore.
[01:02] Maya: is that something you can fix without data loss?
[01:05] Jon: likely yes, we can re-ingest, but we need to confirm TTL on the raw buckets. if raw data is gone, we'll need a compensating control doc for the auditor.
[01:15] Elena: ok please flag either way. also we should decide on the audit kickoff week — auditors prefer early April, week of april 6 looked ok in my notes.
[01:26] Priya: finance is fine with april 6, we need to have vendor invoices reconciled first though, i'll confirm by end of week.
[01:33] Maya: noted. next: KMS / HSM key rotation — Tom do you have anything from legal re vendor terms?
[01:41] Tom: nothing blocking yet, but the renewal has a clause on key custody change — if we move key custodianship we need 60 days notice to the vendor and there's an audit of key export controls. i'll put a short memo on the thread.
[01:55] Samir: from infra side, the planned rotation is simple — rotate keys in staging, validate encryption at rest, then schedule prod rotation during the maintenance window. question is whether we need an HSM upgrade budget for Q2.
[02:08] Priya: we might. I have a vendor invoice cycle in late march, if the HSM upgrade is capital expense we need it in the Q2 CapEx packet by april 1. can you provide estimates?
[02:19] Samir: i'll pull a ballpark today, maybe 2 options — managed HSM or bring-your-own. i prefer managed for reduce ops overhead, but it is pricier.
[02:29] Maya: ok add that to action items. next item SSO/SAML provisioning ticket — Jon?
[02:34] Jon: yea we saw a user provisioning failure sunday night where service accounts weren't mapped correctly in Okta; it caused 3 engineers to lose access. root cause seems to be a mapping change rolled out without a canary. i've opened a ticket with Okta support and i'll include a step for emergency revoke.
[02:49] Lydia: that impacted payroll batch? i saw a payroll job re-run on monday morning, we had to do manual step.
[02:55] Priya: yes we had to reprocess one vendor batch, small impact but it's on record for this quarter.
[03:01] Jon: apologies — we'll add a canary and a runbook.
[03:05] Maya: please add the runbook link to the ticket. next, maintenance windows: proposal to move weekly patch window to saturday 02:00-04:00 PT to minimize user impact, thoughts?
[03:18] Jake: that's fine from facilities perspective, low traffic, HVAC is unaffected.
[03:22] Samir: that slot works for infra too, we can schedule dry-run.
[03:25] Priya: finance prefers weekday? it complicates payroll processes if patches touch payroll systems.
[03:31] Lydia: payroll can plan around it if we get at least 72 hours notice, saturday window is ok.
[03:36] Maya: alright we'll go with sat 02:00-04:00 PT for now, run a dry-run next friday in staging — Jon please schedule.
[03:44] Jon: will do.
[03:46] Maya: clerical item — CapEx approval timeline for HSM, Priya you'll confirm?
[03:51] Priya: yes i'll put the CapEx doc in the board packet, target april 1 for submission.
[03:56] Maya: legal review for KMS contract, Tom to review and flag impacts.
[03:59] Tom: yep i'll look at export controls and any cross-border clauses, will add comments to doc.
[04:05] Elena: also — encryption evidence: we need screenshots of key policies and proof of key rotation plan; if we use managed HSM the vendor provides certs, so that may simplify SOC 2 artifacts.
[04:15] Samir: thats true, managed option gives vendor attestations but increases cost.
[04:19] Priya: we should evaluate TCO, please include OPEX vs CapEx calculation.
[04:24] Samir: will do.
[04:26] Maya: next — backup verification. last week a restore test had a missing schema in one DB snapshot, any updates?
[04:33] Jon: we ran another restore in staging yesterday; all tables restored but one migration hook failed due to a version mismatch. we patched the migration and re-ran, successful. i'll document the steps.
[04:45] Elena: flag that for change mgmt evidence — migrations etc.
[04:48] Maya: good. procurement/legal: vendor checklist and invoicing cadence, Priya?
[04:53] Priya: invoice cadence — we have a backlog of three vendors that need reissue; i'm pinging them this afternoon. also one vendor needs a W9 update, Lydia handling payroll vendor tax docs.
[05:05] Lydia: yep i'll reach out and confirm tax forms are up to date.
[05:08] Tom: small note — for any cross-border vendor payments, legal wants currency clauses ok'd.
[05:13] Priya: noted.
[05:15] Maya: any security incidents since last sync?
[05:18] Elena: no new incidents, just the SSO provisioning outage which we're tracking. we've filed the RCA and added mitigation steps.
[05:25] Maya: great. open items recap before we wrap:
[05:28] Maya: 1) Elena to upload SOC 2 evidence index and confirm log retention
[05:33] Maya: 2) Jon to verify retention and re-ingest logs if possible, otherwise write compensating control
[05:38] Maya: 3) Samir to provide HSM cost estimates (managed vs self-host)
[05:42] Maya: 4) Priya to confirm CapEx submission date and vendor invoice reconciliation
[05:46] Maya: 5) Tom to review contract clauses for KMS renewal
[05:50] Maya: 6) Jon to schedule dry-run patch in staging and update runbook
[05:54] Priya: one more ask — can security provide a short summary email for execs on the impact and timeline?
[05:58] Elena: yes i'll draft an exec summary and share by tuesday.
[06:02] Maya: perfect. any other business?
[06:05] Jake: facilities note — planned power dip in Bldg C on april 9, may affect some racks if not on UPS. i'll send details.
[06:12] Maya: thanks Jake, Samir can you check which racks are on redundant power and confirm?
[06:17] Samir: yes i'll produce a short list and share to the group.
[06:20] Maya: ok last thing — auditors and scheduling, Priya and Elena to coordinate with external auditor and pick a firm slot week of april 6, Maya will attend the kickoff.
[06:31] Priya: noted.
[06:33] Maya: thanks everyone, we'll follow up on action items in the thread; next sync same time next week. meeting adjourned.
[44:30] End of recording (approx)
